title: 짧은 문장 소리 내어 읽기 2: 소리 변화
objective: Read 식당에서 밥을 먹어요 as [식땅에서 바블 머거요].
summary: Read short Korean sentences aloud using four sound changes.

task.title: Read and find the sound
task.line: Say each word or sentence aloud, then choose, write, or check the real sound in [ ].

letters.as: Linking: a final consonant moves to the next vowel (ㅇ).
Nasal: before ㄴ or ㅁ, final ㅂ becomes ㅁ and final ㄱ becomes ㅇ.
Silent ㅎ: a final ㅎ before a vowel is not pronounced.
Tense: after final ㄱ or ㅂ, ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅅ ㅈ become ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ.

exercises: Choose the real sound, (a) or (b): ① 음악 — (a) [음악] (b) [으막] ② 입니다 — (a) [입니다] (b) [임니다] ③ 놓아요 — (a) [노아요] (b) [노하요]
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 책이 ② 국물 ③ 넣어요
Which sound change happens? Write linking, nasal, silent ㅎ, or tense: ① 숙제 ② 밥을 ③ 작년
Read the sentence aloud and write the real sound in [ ]: ① 집에 가요. ② 학생입니다. ③ 물이 좋아요.
answers: ① tense [숙쩨] ② linking [바블] ③ nasal [장년]
